erin (release-ops): FYI: brief interruptible release freeze tomorrow 03:00-05:00 UTC for a metadata-store migration. Soft freeze window 02:30-05:30 UTC. Please ack if you own a rollout lane. :loud_sound:

rahul (eng-runtime): Acked. We'll lock model pushes and hold autoscale bursts.

chao (eng-platform): Platform will pause infra merges touching prod from 02:00-06:00 UTC. Exceptions via release-exception form only.

marta (eng-sre): Oncall doing -2h smoke and -15m full preflight. Will enable verbose tracing for +48h.

sylvie (product): PMs: stop any ramping feature flags and don't schedule experiments crossing the window.

erin (release-ops): Canary pattern: 3 waves (5m, 10m, 20m). Gates: error-rate, p99 latency, and DB error spikes. Rollback if gate fails.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: metadata-cutover-2202 at 03:10 UTC (erin).

rahul (eng-runtime): Note: websocket sessions may see brief 502s. We'll enable read-through fallback for 60s to reduce user errors.

erin (release-ops): Runbook + exception form: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/metadata-cutover and https://redwood.internal/forms/release-exception. Final: ack here if you own rollout tasks. :white_check_mark:
